outcome_criterion: All three gates YES: (1) tsc + lint + tests + build all green; (2) live E2E proof — real candidates returned from >=2 platforms including LinkedIn via API, real compliant approved outreach sent, zero mock/demo data in the core sourcing path; (3) Codex adversarial architecture/readability review of the full repo ends 'VERDICT: SHIP'. Final sign-off: Tony. AND (4) Owner acceptance path: Tony pastes a real need (copy-pasted email) into intake, the sourcing loop starts, agents run, and real candidates fitting the request are returned to him — no manual developer intervention.

premortem_risks: R1: AI quota exhaustion (Codex ChatGPT limits, Claude session limits) stalls the push mid-wave
R2: OneDrive Files-On-Demand checkout jams next build / crashes test tooling (has happened twice)
R3: Concurrent writers (second Claude session, Codex CLI) clobber the working tree or double-commit
R4: 'LinkedIn with the API' expectation collides with compliance reality (no RSC partnership; manual-only wire enforcement is deliberate)
R5: Live provider keys/accounts absent (Tavily, GitHub, Apollo, Seamless, Meta WhatsApp, Resend) — sourcing/outreach cannot be proven real without Tony provisioning
R6: store.ts refactor destabilizes demo showpieces Tony relies on for demos
R7: scope growth (winlog + exec dashboard + Databricks) risks diluting the core paste→candidates proof if built before Wave 1 ships
R8: a security boundary (salary/injection) is exactly where a single review misses holes — the roleSummary=JSON.stringify(brief) leak was already live and unnoticed
premortem_mitigations: M1: batch codex work into brief files ready to fire at reset windows; solo-visionary lanes continue; loud DEGRADED banners; never retry-loop
M2: all build/deploy proof from Vercel/CI or a clone at ~/AI-Brain-build (non-OneDrive); local gate only for fast iteration
M3: claim ledger in _relay + fresh git status before every wave; atomic commits; worktrees for parallel rocks
M4: m7 makes the LinkedIn ruling an explicit Tony decision with options+recommendation; scope stays compliant-by-default (licensed SERP discovery + assisted-manual + documented partnership path)
M5: key-provisioning checklist to Tony early (m7/m8 front-loaded); canary workspace; honest dry-run states distinguished from failures
M6: demo mode preserved behind flags; behavioral tests before/after each slice; one slice per commit with full gate
M7: Wave discipline — Wave 1 (m1-m12: real sourcing/keys/LinkedIn/mailbox/acceptance) ships and is Owner-approved BEFORE Wave 2 (m13-m15) starts; each wave is its own rocket-fuel Same Page Meeting
M8: context-whitelist (model can't leak what it never receives) + mandatory 3-lens adversarial verify before the security rock ships; belt-and-suspenders input-detect + output-scan
